"Strange Brew" is a song by the British rock band Cream.
First released as a single in May 1967 in the UK and July 1967 in the US, it was later added to their second studio album Disraeli Gears.
The song features Eric Clapton on lead vocals rather than the usual lead by Jack Bruce.
Goodbye (also called Goodbye Cream) is the fourth and final album by Cream, with three tracks recorded live, and three recorded in the studio.
The album was released after Cream disbanded in November 1968.

Background and recording
Just before Cream's third album, Wheels of Fire, was to be released, the group's manager Robert Stigwood announced that the group would disband after a farewell tour and a final concert at the Royal Albert Hall in November.
